title: Comorbidity between depression and anxiety: assessing the role of bridge mental states in dynamic psychological networks
sample_size: 143 participants in comorbid group, 40 in depression-only group, 37 in anxiety-only group
limitations: - Sample size for single disorder groups may be too small for reliable estimates; - Group-level analyses may not capture individual differences; - Model assumes linear dynamics and fixed lag; - Potential confounding by unmeasured variables; - Limited to specific mental states assessed.
notes: Data are not freely available in a public repository but can be requested via the NESDA Data Access Committee. The study used a multilevel VAR model with Bayesian estimation, which is computationally intensive and may not capture all dynamic relationships.
